description: This Java source file defines a utility class FactoryResetUtils for testing factory reset procedures on Android devices. It includes methods to create a temporary guest file and verify its existence, primarily used in automated testing scenarios.

classes.name: FactoryResetUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating and verifying a temporary factory reset indicator file on an Android device during tests.

methods.name: createTemporaryGuestFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary guest file on the device and asserts its existence.

methods.name: assertTemporaryGuestFileExists
methods.description: Checks whether the temporary guest file exists on the device and asserts the expected condition.
